svg.text: Concept 8 · device broker accounts are made by the backend on the VPS, but live on the Pi gateway broker · the main path
compose.cloud.yml + the VPS column of .env, backend 1.5.0
for the gateway on the topic
(the same address is typed in the board's portal)
How an account is made at a gateway behind a router
the backend publishes setDefaultACLAccess, then createClient at the central broker, topic msh-gateway/pi1/dynamic-security/v1
the bridge carries it down to the gateway as $CONTROL/dynamic-security/v1: the plugin makes the account
the answer …/response goes up through the same bridge to the backend: 201, the board can connect
no answer within 3 seconds: tried once more, then 503; the database is unchanged, but a command already
sent may still be carried out by the gateway as soon as the bridge is back: repeat the step
simulated lab, TLS bridge: register 201 in 0.15–0.31 s · Deactivate 0.18 s
the board's portal: Server address = your place's SERVER_URL, exactly (without :8081)
Broker address = the gateway's or the laptop's IP (port 1883 on the home Wi-Fi)
The free path: everything on the Pi
the center on the Pi too (1884), a LAN bridge
without a port: the Pi's port 80 goes to
its edge certificate not tested with an ESP32
Moving the old Module 21 accounts to automatic ones (per device)
step 1 = POST /devices/<id>/key from Bruno (Module 21); the /fleet dashboard has no key-rotation button
without step 3, deactivating that device brings its old key back to life (lab); a gateway restart keeps the queue (simulated lab: Restored 5 client messages, 0 readings lost)
